summary: Media IPC got more robust lifecycle and async handling: the media engine child actor now shuts down more cleanly and the remote media engine is initialized only once, MFCDMChild (the CDM/DRM child path) has improved promise handling, and plumbing was added so the RemoteDecoderModule can support hardware offload. Together these make remote decoding, DRM handoffs, and parent⇄content process interactions more reliable and ready for **hardware-accelerated remote decoding**.
